versions.content: If CanNmSynchronizedPncShutdown Enabled is set to TRUE , the transmission of PN shutdown messages is active for this NM - Channel and no transmission confirmation of a previous call to transmit a NM - PDU as PN shutdown message on this NM - Channel is pending, then the CanNm module shall reque st in the next main function call a transmission of a NM - PDU as PN shutdown message by calling CanIf_Transmit .
